$comment: Run-only tsconfig for scripts/reparse-game.ts. Used by `tsx` via `--tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.reparse.json` so the editGame import chain can resolve the `server-only` marker package and `next/cache` outside a Next request context (same stubs Vitest uses — see scripts/tsconfig.audit.json for why). `@format-pack` stays private-first: on a private-pack league, run the script from a checkout that carries src/format-packs/private/ so editGame's EPB evolution recheck reads the league's real tuning. The root tsconfig.json is NOT modified, so the Next.js server-only guard stays intact for the app build. This file is NOT consumed by `tsc --noEmit` (typecheck) — typecheck uses the root tsconfig which already includes scripts/*.ts via **/*.ts.
